summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong requirements coverage. Unit tests (secret-rotation-validator.test.ts) thoroughly exercise classification logic, config parsing, output formatting, CLI argument handling, and option resolution. Integration tests (workflow.test.ts) validate workflow structure, actionlint compliance, and run 3 fixture cases end-to-end via act with exact expected-value assertions. Fixtures use clean factory patterns (makeSecret()). Deterministic `now` injection enables reproducible tests. Strengths: complete coverage of all stated task requirements, extensive error paths and boundary conditions (warning window edges, overdue secrets, date validation), proper assertion of exit codes and output grouping. Weaknesses: parseIsoDate/formatIsoDate lack direct unit tests despite complex date logic; no env var parsing edge cases (e.g., non-integer from env); output format tests tightly couple to rendering details; act integration slow (~5 min total, Docker-dependent). Act requirement limits to 3 test cases but covers the key scenarios well. Would reliably catch regressions in classification, formatting, CLI parsing, and workflow setup.
